request.text: One crude vehicle rivet-gun burst. Immediate attack, three cracks in 0.6 s, short metal body, decay to silence; no reload. Timbre: a hard pneumatic rivet mechanism and rattling steel bolt. Close foundry steel, blunt low-mid weight, analog grit, short concrete reflection. 1.5 seconds. Original isolated effect; no music, no voice.
